description_en: Unassigns one or more IPv6 addresses from an Elastic Network Interface (ENI)
description_zh: 回收一个或多个弹性网卡IPv6地址
kebab_example: aliyun ecs unassign-ipv6-addresses --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --network-interface-id eni-bp14v2sdd3v8ht0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnassignIpv6Addresses

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Elastic Network Interface (ENI). You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 弹性网卡所在地域的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Elastic Network Interface (ENI)
parameters.name: network_interface_id

parameters.help_en: One or more IPv6 addresses to delete. Valid values of N: 1 to 10
parameters.help_zh: 一个或多个需要删除的IPv6地址。N的取值范围为1~10
parameters.name: ipv6_address

parameters.help_en: One or more IPv6 prefixes to unassign. Valid values of N: 1 to 10
parameters.help_zh: 一个或多个需要回收的IPv6前缀。N的取值范围为1~10
parameters.name: ipv6_prefix
